data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 was GBP 337.016m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows no net prior-year movement for underwriting years 2016 and 2017 (net prior-year development approximately nil). However, the Managing Agent reports significant prior-year deterioration on specific portfolios (notably Woodstock and Personal Accident discontinued in 2018, plus Financial Lines, General Casualty and Hull) and notes adverse development relating to prior-year catastrophe events (principally Hurricane Irma). Current-year catastrophe activity (Hurricane Dorian, Typhoon Faxai and Typhoon Hagibis) together with prior-year deterioration contributed to net catastrophe-related losses (net) of GBP 16.7m in 2019, but this did not result in a material aggregated gross prior-year reserve movement in the gross claims development triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: The underwriting result in 2019 was affected by catastrophe events mainly Hurricane Dorian, Typhoon Faxai and Typhoon Hagibis, as well as deterioration on prior year catastrophe events mainly Hurricane Irma.
Collectively, these represented net losses of GBP 16,700k.
There has also been significant prior year deterioration on Woodstock and Personal Accident that were discontinued in 2018 and Financial Lines, General Casualty and Hull.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was computed from the gross claims development triangle (Note: amounts in the triangle are presented in GBP 931,000 units i.e. GBP 115,879 = 115,879 in table GBP '000). The triangle shows no net movement for underwriting years <=2017 (calculated PYD = nil). The Managing Agent narrative references "significant prior year deterioration" on specific portfolios and prior-year catastrophe deterioration (e.g. Hurricane Irma) and reports collective net catastrophe losses of GBP 16.7m (net of reinsurance) for 2019 events; these net figures are not the same as gross prior-year reserve movement and no gross PYD figure is explicitly stated in the movement notes. RITC of earlier years appears in the 2018 reconciliation but the 2019 triangle as presented excludes an aggregated '2015 & prior' column and therefore the triangle comparison for 2016/2017 was used. Prior-year movement therefore derived from triangle per the specification (confidence 0.8).
